response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong testing culture, mentoring inclination, and some high-throughput distributed-systems exposure, but he falls well short of the core requirements: his C++ experience is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments plus a thesis project (versus the required 8 years), his career centers on web/full-stack work in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, and he has no formal technical-leadership or cloud-platform ownership role comparable to what this position demands.
strengths: Low-latency, high-scale systems experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (millions of HTTP requests per second)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, plus active mentoring via workshops and courses
Broad, adaptable background spanning backend, infrastructure tooling, Kubernetes, and open-source project ownership
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (~7 months professionally)
No demonstrated technical-lead role managing cross-team priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
Limited large-scale cloud compute/infrastructure architecture experience; career is predominantly product/full-stack web development

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership track record
